issues.title: World-focused discovery prints every world and Grant
issues.expected: A focused workflow should be able to narrow Context discovery to task-1 or the current subtree while preserving Grant annotations.
issues.actual: Every bare Contexts call printed 105 catalog rows (125 raw lines), including unrelated task-2 and task-3 namespaces; no filter was available.
issues.workaround: Use literal Find/List with an exact task-1 root after manually locating it in the global catalog.

issues.title: Recursive List becomes an unbounded terminal dump
issues.expected: A recursive inspection should remain navigable or provide a bounded/summary handoff while retaining exact data access.
issues.actual: The accumulated participant List occupied 904 raw lines and the public wiki List occupied 580 raw lines in plain output.
issues.workaround: List one exact child at a time or use literal/semantic retrieval before List.

issues.title: Compare auto-types Memory endpoints but rejects peers in one Context
issues.expected: Two explicit CONTEXT:UID endpoints should compare the selected Memories even when their owner Context is the same.
issues.actual: The command rejected two distinct facility Memory UIDs with 'Compare requires two distinct Contexts.'
issues.workaround: Compare Memories owned by distinct Contexts or compare their whole peer Contexts.

issues.title: Quality finders expose incompatible scope grammars
issues.expected: Find Ambiguities and Find Conflicts should share the direct/recursive scope vocabulary already used by Find Duplicates and Find Redundancies, or clearly present an equivalent noninteractive range control.
issues.actual: Both commands rejected --direct at parser level and suggested --select; positional exact Context worked on later attempts.
issues.workaround: Use a positional exact Context for direct analysis, --all for Profile breadth, or --select only in a TTY.

issues.title: Reference cannot snapshot a readable granted Context
issues.expected: Reference's Source Context route should resolve a readable granted public Context, as its exact granted-Memory route and Embed's whole granted-Context route do.
issues.actual: Reference reported task-1/campus-wiki/building-access does not exist, although Contexts/List/Show resolved it and later granted Memory Reference and whole-Context Embed succeeded.
issues.workaround: Reference an exact public Memory or Embed the public Context; use Copy when an owned snapshot is required.

issues.title: Hard-bounded Chunk emits semantically incomplete fragments
issues.expected: Clause chunking should preserve independently intelligible atomic Memories or visibly warn that a hard character cap forced dependent fragments.
issues.actual: A valid clause/max-char split produced '...during the' and 'construction period.' as separate Memories; Find Ambiguities immediately flagged both as mutually dependent underspecified fragments.
issues.workaround: Use a larger max_chars value and immediately run Find Ambiguities before consuming chunks.

issues.title: Compare ledger waits 109 seconds then loses the analysis
issues.expected: A ledger comparison should return a valid exhaustive relation ledger or fail promptly without consuming a long provider-repair cycle.
issues.actual: After 109.62 seconds, Compare failed because provider repair assigned DISTINCT to invalid PEER sides; no usable ledger was published.
issues.workaround: Use snapshot Compare for a summary and separate Find/Fit reports for relation evidence.

issues.title: Fit treats a time-bounded exception as incompatible with usual hours
issues.expected: A June 24–August 23 construction-specific 7 a.m.–11 p.m. schedule can coexist with a store's usual recess 9 a.m.–6 p.m. schedule as an explicit temporary override.
issues.actual: Fit returned NO and treated the ordinary 'usual recess hours' statement as an unconditional conflict with the dated construction update.
issues.workaround: State override precedence explicitly in the background or preserve the normal and temporary schedules in separate time-scoped Contexts.

issues.title: Whole-frame Atomize cannot reach semantic chunk normal form
issues.expected: Whole direct construction frames should either produce complete reviewable Atomize sessions or identify a bounded input-size/schema limit before provider work.
issues.actual: The 19-Memory facility frame ran for 51.07 s and returned 14 UNCERTAIN dispositions; the 15-Memory parking frame ran for 42.54 s and returned one UNCERTAIN disposition. Both rejected the whole result with no Context publication, while three focused-Memory routes succeeded.
issues.workaround: Use exact Memory Atomize routes and review each source-bound result; do not treat focused success as whole-frame coverage.

issues.title: Cross-frame Audit approaches or exceeds the bounded call timeout
issues.expected: A complete saved cross-Context Audit should finish within the declared 300-second bounded-call window or fail early with a size/cost diagnostic.
issues.actual: Building-access against route-changes reached the 300-second harness timeout with no completed artifact; temporary-parking against building-access completed only after 252.01 s. Single-frame Audits completed in 18.29–30.38 s.
issues.workaround: Run single-frame Audit snapshots and a separate Check Conformance call for the cross-area rule frame, preserving both receipts.

issues.title: Impact cannot consume a saved Audit session
issues.expected: A saved read-only Audit artifact should have an operation-aware Impact route, consistent with other saved semantic analysis sessions.
issues.actual: `impact audit --session deadbeef` was rejected by the command router with `No such command 'audit'`; the failure occurred at routing before artifact lookup, even though Audit is a saved session family and `review audit` exists.
issues.workaround: Use `review audit --session … --snapshot` to inspect the immutable artifact; no Audit-specific Impact preview is available.

issues.title: Rationale unexpectedly switches from English to Chinese
issues.expected: Rationale prose should follow the English source and surrounding CLI language unless a target language is explicitly requested.
issues.actual: The first facility Rationale rendered its entire provenance explanation in Chinese. The four otherwise equivalent construction Rationale routes rendered English.
issues.workaround: Use Trace for language-stable lineage facts, or rerun Rationale and manually verify its prose against the typed provenance events.

issues.title: Bounded Elaborate invents venue verification procedures
issues.expected: The inline rule requiring only verified venues, dates, and reservation status should not produce concrete operational channels, active/pending booking states, or loading-entrance details absent from the verified construction Source.
issues.actual: Elaborate created three UNVERIFIED/BEST_EFFORT Memories that introduced an auditorium reservation channel, active and pending booking states, and a separate loading entrance for equipment. These details were not in the verified event-relocation Memories.
issues.workaround: Keep Elaborate output in checkpointed scratch, treat UNVERIFIED as non-publishable, and Revert unless every generated detail can be independently grounded.

issues.title: Audit evidence runner did not recover bracketed session IDs
issues.expected: The audit harness should recover the saved `SESSION [uid]` token so the later counted Review can consume that exact artifact.
issues.actual: The world-local runner recognized only a printed `mem review audit --session` command, not Audit's actual `SESSION [uid]` header, so Review attempts 1 and 4 used the sentinel `deadbeef` and failed. The underlying Audit artifacts were successfully saved.
issues.workaround: Read the bracketed SESSION UID from raw Audit output; do not attribute these Review failures to the product.

issues.title: Audit harness interruption lost Eval stdout after the child had exited
issues.expected: The world runner should persist the child output and attempt record before an operator interruption can leave a counted call unrecorded.
issues.actual: Eval M2 completed a durable 1/1 PASS run and the mandatory post-child identity assertion passed, but Ctrl-C arrived during the subsequent lane digest. The in-process stdout/cost wrapper was lost before phase-admin persistence.
issues.workaround: Recover the counted attempt from the unique durable Eval run JSON and exact post-child identity host read; never rerun the mem command.

issues.title: Same-world Context Import cannot create an aliased by-value scratch copy
issues.expected: Importing a registered task-1 Context by value under a fresh scratch name should either create an independent identity or expose an explicit same-Profile copy route.
issues.actual: Both direct and recursive Context Import stopped because the managed source Context UID already existed in the active Study Profile, even though each `--as` destination was fresh. Exact Memory Import into scratch later succeeded.
issues.workaround: Use exact Memory Import for a selective by-value copy, or Branch/Copy within the active Profile when source identity already exists.

issues.title: Init creates a missing parent chain without --parents
issues.expected: `init task-1/participant/admin-v2-scratch/missing-parent/leaf` should reject the absent lexical parent unless `--parents` is supplied, keeping the explicit parent-expansion method distinct.
issues.actual: The command exited 0 and initialized the leaf even though `missing-parent` did not exist and `--parents` was absent.
issues.workaround: Host-check the parent catalog before Init when missing-parent creation would broaden scope; use `--parents` only when the full chain is intentional.
